rationale: The first reply treated 'e5' as the model, listed contact cleaning first, and invited the error number. The second reply said Error 5 'most often means the battery is wearing out' and pushed a battery before contacts were confirmed, which was over-confident, though the customer had already cleaned them. The final reply correctly attributed the fix to dirty contacts and advised skipping the reseat and watching for recurrence. It never raised the dock sitting at an angle on thick carpet, which the customer had not mentioned, and it gave no unplug-before-cleaning warning, so the result is useful but not ideal.</br>
